recognize_zh: 縱膈腫塊切片同時有兩個區域：左上為結節硬化型何杰金淋巴瘤（NSHL），CD30 染出散在大型 Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg 細胞；右下為密集單一樣的骨髓肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma），骨髓標記瀰漫陽性，FISH 顯示腫瘤細胞紅綠訊號分離（基因重組）。
features: Low power H&E: two juxtaposed areas labeled NSHL and myeloid sarcoma, the latter a dense sheet of monotonous cells
CD30 immunostain: scattered large cells with membranous and Golgi-dot staining in a background of small non-staining lymphocytes (Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells)
Diffuse granular cytoplasmic staining of the sheet-like infiltrate with a myeloid marker in panel C
Interphase FISH with a break-apart probe: one nucleus with two fused (yellow) signals and a larger nucleus with separated red and green signals, indicating rearrangement
describe_en: Sections of the mediastinal mass (H&E) show two distinct components: one with a mixed inflammatory background containing scattered large atypical cells, and an adjacent area composed of diffuse sheets of monotonous intermediate-sized cells. CD30 highlights scattered large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in the first component, whereas the sheet-like infiltrate shows diffuse positivity for a myeloid marker. Break-apart FISH demonstrates split signals in tumor nuclei, indicating a gene rearrangement. Findings are consistent with relapsed nodular sclerosis classic Hodgkin lymphoma with a synchronous therapy-related myeloid sarcoma in the same mass.

ddx.dx: Syncytial variant of nodular sclerosis Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: Syncytial cHL sheets are composed of CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells, whereas myeloid sarcoma sheets are CD30-negative and express MPO/CD33/lysozyme.
ALCL shows sheets of CD30-positive hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and often ALK, unlike the myeloid-marker-positive sheet here.
PMBL sheets express CD20/PAX5 strongly with compartmentalizing sclerosis and lack myeloid markers.

ddx.dx: Thymic carcinoma or germ cell tumor
ddx.vs: Epithelial and germ cell tumors are keratin, SALL4 or OCT3/4 positive rather than myeloid markers.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, myeloid marker; FISH
